nodes.name: Marlow
nodes.bio: The narrator and protagonist, a sailor who travels up the Congo River.

nodes.name: Mr. Kurtz
nodes.bio: A charismatic ivory trader who has become a god-like figure in the jungle.

nodes.name: Fresleven
nodes.bio: The previous captain of the steamer, killed in a dispute over hens.

nodes.name: Captain
nodes.bio: The Swedish captain of the steamer that takes Marlow to the Outer Station.

nodes.name: Van Shuyten
nodes.bio: A trading company director who helped Marlow get his appointment.
